messages:
lina: Auditor asked for a compact mapping: what artefacts prove our RBAC change process (approvals, merges), where those artefacts live, plus KMS key usage logs and any linkage between vulnerabilities/incidents and RBAC changes. Need minimal bundle + walk-through.

tom: Short answer: PRs in infra-policies repo (labelled `compliance/rbac-change`) + GitHub org audit logs for approvals/merge events + CI pipeline run metadata. Example PR URL (redacted): https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra-policies/pull/614

eric: For GitHub audit exports we store NDJSON in s3://ci-archives/github-audit/YYYY/MM/DD/*.ndjson. To surface merges/approvals use fields: action, actor, target, created_at. Quick Athena/Glue SQL to pull merges across a range:```sql
SELECT created_at, action, actor.login, target, metadata
FROM github_audit_logs
WHERE action IN ('pull_request.merged','pull_request.reviewed')
  AND created_at BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28';
```

tom: KMS: CloudTrail contains key usage and key policy changes. We export relevant events to s3://redwood-compliance/kms-events/YYYY-MM-DD/*.json (1 year hot, 4 years archived). Example CloudTrail filter for audit: eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" AND eventName in (Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion).

eric: If you want a SQL-style example over Glue tables for KMS:```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName AS principal, requestParameters.keyId, awsRegion, eventID
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com'
  AND eventTime >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND requestParameters.keyId IN ('arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345');
```

tom: Linking vuln triage -> RBAC change: our incident tracker stores remediation references in the triage notes (format: "remediates: PR#614" or "fix: commit abc123"). Use our incidents index to generate a crosswalk CSV. Splunk example:```spl
index=incidents sourcetype=incident_notes earliest=-90d
| rex "(?i)remediates:\s*PR[# ]?(?<pr>\d+)"
| where isnotnull(pr)
| stats values(pr) as prs by incident_id, short_description
```

eric: If the mitigation involved a key rotation, include: rotation runbook (docs/playbooks/kms-rotation.md), CloudTrail RotateKey/CreateKey events, deploy pipeline ID, and post-deploy verification logs.

security-bot: Evidence package queued: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2959999999-evidence-bundle.zip (contents: rbacs.json, github_audit.ndjson, cloudtrail_kms.ndjson, incident_crosswalk.csv, retention_policy_signed.pdf). Package checksum: sha256:9f2c7b4a5d2e5f3b8c1c3a7d9f4e2b1c8d7e6f5a2b1c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2

lina: Auditor also wants retention justification for logs >90 days. We will include Confluence retention policy snapshot and a signed PDF from security lead: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/log-retention-v2 (attach snapshot).

eric: Action items and owners: 1) tom: export PRs + GitHub audit slice (today EOD). 2) eric: export CloudTrail KMS events + rotation events (include key ARNs). 3) lina: generate incidents->PR crosswalk CSV and assemble bundle. 4) security-bot: produce ZIP and post S3 link + checksum.

tom: I'll include branch-protection change diffs as well and the CI run IDs showing the gated merge.

security-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2959999999-evidence-bundle.zip (presigned-links available on request, default expiry 48h).

lina: Thanks. I'll draft a one-page mapping doc for the auditor referencing each file in the bundle and offering scoped S3 access if they need raw logs. :thumbsup:
